C2.population: every delivery of a monotone / scrutiny / scrutiny_soft run that did not fail (unsafe ones are the sharp cases)
C2.baseline: plain v3.6 decision on the same saved frames: no memory/advice caution (tau_mem None), no scrutiny; all saved side views (also scrutiny extra views) and, separately, only the standard L/R views

closed_loop_vs_W.rule: 4 or more of 16 (25%) or a Wilson lower bound above W upper bound: closed-loop eps is above the image-level value (arrival jitter, V lesson); Sec. 1.1 item 2(e) becomes a finding and the "eps small enough" sentence is rewritten, not the table

C4.abstract_sentence_must_print: ours vs control, not only ours vs naive; cost sentence "at the simulated false-alarm rate"

C5.rule: all 6 paired differences positive give p = 0.031; a tie or one negative difference = not supported (counts in Nfailed)

C6.rule: extra time <= 1.5 W with W = median(S controls) - median(N controls) > 0 (W <= 0: "not testable", not "passed"); lost deliveries <= the registered Poisson-binomial 95th percentile (4 of 24); 5 or more fails the cost claim (the arena has no soft refusal: do not explain it away with the depot)

C7.reading: steering direction observed but not significant

operator.pilot_gate: intent acceptance >= 75% (Amendment 2); exact extraction is reported, not gated

C8.note: a missed extraction makes naive behave like control: report A1 by channel (C3 by_channel) next to this table
